guest.title: You are practising as a guest

codeSent.title: Check your email
codeSent.ifAccount: If an account uses <addr>{email}</addr>, we have sent it a 6-digit code. It expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. It can take a minute to arrive, so check your spam folder too.
codeSent.ifAccountResent: If an account uses <addr>{email}</addr>, we have sent it a new 6-digit code and the earlier one no longer works. It expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. It can take a minute to arrive, so check your spam folder too.
codeSent.toAddress: We have sent a 6-digit code to <addr>{email}</addr>. It expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. It can take a minute to arrive, so check your spam folder too.
codeSent.toAddressResent: We have sent a new 6-digit code to <addr>{email}</addr>, and the earlier one no longer works. It expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. It can take a minute to arrive, so check your spam folder too.
codeSent.sendFallback: We could not send a code. Please try again.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.rateLimitedMinutes: Too many attempts. Please try again in about {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.signInRateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Please try again later.
errors.signInRateLimitedMinutes: Too many sign-in attempts. Please try again in about {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.signUpRateLimited: Too many accounts have been created from this connection. Please try again later.
errors.signUpRateLimitedMinutes: Too many accounts have been created from this connection. Please try again in about {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.invalidEmail: Check the email address — that one does not look like a valid address.
errors.signInIncomplete: Enter a valid email address and your password.
errors.invalidCredentials: That email address and password do not match.
errors.signupFailed: That account could not be created. If you already have an account, sign in instead.
errors.codeFormat: Enter the 6-digit code from the email.
errors.codeInvalid: That code is not right. Check the most recent email we sent you and try again.
errors.codeExpired: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.codeLocked: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new one.
errors.emailUnavailable: We could not send the email just now. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.accountRequired: Create an account first: guest sessions have no email address.
errors.unauthorized: You need to be signed in to do that.
errors.forbidden: This request was blocked for security reasons.
errors.serverError: Something went wrong on our side.

password.tooShort: Use at least {min} characters. A short phrase works well.
password.containsEmail: Do not use your email address in your password.
password.tooCommon: That password is too easy to guess. Try a phrase only you would write.
password.repeated: That password repeats a single character.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Sign in to keep your practice history, bookmarks and review queue on every device you study from.
signIn.guestBody: Signing in to an existing account switches away from this guest session, and the practice you have done as a guest stays with the guest session rather than moving across. <link>Create an account instead</link> to keep it.
signIn.formHeading: Sign in with your email address
signIn.about: Your practice history, bookmarks and review queue follow your account, so you can study on one device and pick up on another. No account yet? Creating one takes an email address and a password, nothing else.
signIn.browseExams: Browse the exam guides without signing in
signIn.noReset: We cannot reset a password for you yet, so keep yours somewhere safe.

form.useCode: Email me a sign-in code instead
form.fallback: We could not sign you in. Please try again.

codeSignIn.title: Sign in with an email code
codeSignIn.description: Sign in to your account with a one-time code sent to your email address, instead of your password.
codeSignIn.guestBody: Signing in to an existing account switches away from this guest session, and the practice you have done as a guest stays with the guest session. <link>Create an account instead</link> to keep it.
codeSignIn.about: The code works once, for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}, and only for the address it was sent to. Your password stays exactly as it is.

form.usePassword: Sign in with your password instead

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.description: Create a free account to keep your practice history, bookmarks and review queue. An email address and a password are all we ask for.

next.plans: Next: the plans for your {test} preparation.

signUp.guestTitle: Your practice so far will be kept
signUp.guestNone: You are practising as a guest. Creating an account here upgrades that same guest session, so anything you do now stays with you.
signUp.guestSome: You are practising as a guest and have started {count, plural, one {# practice session} other {# practice sessions}}. Creating an account here upgrades that same session, so your history, bookmarks and review queue all carry over.
signUp.visitorBody: Create the account in the same browser you practised in and your guest history, bookmarks and review queue carry straight over to it.
signUp.about: An email address and a password. No payment details, no phone number, and nothing shared with the test makers — we are independent of all of them.
signUp.consent: By creating an account you agree to our <terms>terms</terms>. Our <privacy>privacy notice</privacy> explains what we store, and you can export or delete everything from your account page at any time.

form.emailHintCodes: Used to sign in and for account codes, such as one to confirm this address or reset your password. We send no marketing email.
form.emailHint: Used to sign in and nothing else. We send no marketing email.
form.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. Length matters more than symbols, so a short phrase only you would write — three unrelated words, for example — is both stronger and easier to type on a phone. Do not reuse a password from another site.
form.remaining: {count, plural, one {# more character to go.} other {# more characters to go.}}
form.displayNameHint: What we call you on your own pages. A first name or a nickname is plenty.
form.minorHint: Ticking this only switches off optional data collection for your account; we never ask for a date of birth, and it changes nothing about the practice you get.
form.fallback: That account could not be created.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: Choose a new password with a one-time code sent to the email address on your account.
forgotPassword.about: Your practice history, bookmarks and review queue are not touched. Only the password changes, and every device that was signed in to the account is signed out.

form.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A short phrase only you would write works well. Changing it signs you out on every other device.
form.fallback: We could not reset your password. Please try again.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.description: Confirm the email address on your account with a one-time code.
verifyEmail.confirmedBody: <addr>{email}</addr> is confirmed, so password resets and sign-in codes will reach you. <link>Continue</link>
verifyEmail.about: Your account works whether or not you confirm it. Confirming makes sure that, if you ever forget your password, the reset code reaches you.

form.intro: We will send a 6-digit code to <addr>{email}</addr>. Entering it shows that the address works, so password resets and sign-in codes will reach you.
form.fallback: We could not confirm your address. Please try again.

signIn.subject: {code} is your {site} sign-in code
signIn.intro: Use this code to sign in to {site}:
signIn.ignore: If you did not try to sign in, you can ignore this email. Nobody can sign in with it unless they also have access to this inbox.

resetPassword.subject: {code} is your {site} password reset code
resetPassword.intro: Use this code to choose a new password for your {site} account:
resetPassword.ignore: If you did not ask to reset your password, you can ignore this email. Your password has not changed.

verifyEmail.subject: {code} is your {site} confirmation code
verifyEmail.intro: Use this code to confirm this email address for your {site} account:
verifyEmail.ignore: If you did not create an account with {site}, you can ignore this email. The address stays unconfirmed and you will not hear from us again.

email.expiry: It works once and expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. Enter it on the page where you asked for it. We will never ask you for this code by phone, chat or email.
